title: humanoid_parkour round input
description: Evaluation shape for one round. The course geometry is static and public; each instance's surface friction and wind are drawn at random from `seed` inside the referee (env/sim.instance_spec), so the suite differs every round.

seed.description: Round seed: every instance's friction and wind derive from it. Must be fresh each round, and must not be published while the round is open — a known seed makes the whole suite computable offline. Required rather than optional on purpose: a missing seed would silently freeze the suite instead of failing.

num_instances.description: Evaluation instances. Each draws its own friction and wind, so this sets how well the suite covers the condition ranges — and how much score noise the round carries.

max_steps_per_episode.description: Control-step cap per instance (1 step = 20 ms sim time, so 3000 = 60 s). Lowered from 4000 and hard-capped at 3000 in 0.5.0: this value multiplied by num_instances sets the referee's worst-case wall clock, and at the measured 12.4 ms per control step on evaluation hardware, 24 x 3000 = 72,000 steps lands near 900 s. The maximum is deliberately the timeout budget rather than a physics limit, so no round input can be configured past it. 60 s of sim is ample for a 51 m course; a policy that completes terminates early and never reaches the cap.

deadline_ms.description: Per-/act deadline for the policy, enforced by the referee's HTTP client.

wind_max_ms.description: Upper bound of the per-instance wind draw, in m/s; speed is uniform on [0, this] and direction is uniform over the full circle. Default 14.0 (env/sim.WIND_MAX_MS) is Beaufort 7 at the robot, worth 11.1% of body weight in drag. 0 disables wind. Note this is a CAP on a uniform draw, not a setting: raising it raises the mean instance, it does not make every instance windy. Do not raise it above 20 — drag scales as v^2 and nothing completes the course at 22 m/s in any direction, even with maximum grip. Tunable without a release, but it moves baseline_raw_score.

record_history.description: Write one replayable history file per instance to /data/history/, delivered to the miner as FileType.HISTORY. Optional and default-on; a write failure never affects the score.

history_stride.description: Keep every Nth control step in the history. 1 is all 50 Hz; the default 2 is 25 Hz, which is what a replay renders at anyway, at half the size.
